d: 两次输入逐字符一致才允许继续；不修改用户原始输入，空值不视为确认。
body: <section class="d-confirmation-field-match" aria-label="双字段一致性校验"><label>新口令<input data-first type="password" value=""></label><label>再次输入<input data-second type="password" value=""></label><button type="button" data-confirm>确认口令</button><output class="d-note" data-out role="status" aria-live="polite"></output></section>
